name: Ohio

workersCompensation.fundingModel: MONOPOLISTIC STATE FUND — Ohio is one of four exclusive state fund states; private workers' comp insurance not sold; employers use State Insurance Fund or self-insure

benefitCategories.medical: All reasonable and necessary treatment; BWC-certified providers preferred; fee schedule applies
benefitCategories.temporaryTotal: 72% of wages up to statewide average weekly wage ($1,209/week 2024); max 200 weeks
benefitCategories.permanentPartial: Scheduled awards by % impairment (ORC 4123.57); wage loss supplement available
benefitCategories.permanentTotal: 66 2/3% of wages for life; cost-of-living increases

workersCompensation.initialClaimForm: First Report of an Injury (FROI-1); Application for Benefits

appealLevels.name: District Hearing Officer
appealLevels.deadline: 2 years from injury or last payment

workersCompensation.enforcementPowers: BWC premium audits; compliance investigations; employer penalties
workersCompensation.penalties: Non-compliance penalties; stop-work orders; fraud prosecution; policy cancellation

programs.name: No State Disability Insurance
programs.note: Ohio has no state temporary disability insurance program

programs.name: Ohio Medicaid
programs.eligibility: Low-income; Ohio expanded Medicaid under ACA

programs.name: Ohio Works First (TANF)
programs.administeringBody: Ohio Dept. of Job and Family Services

programs.name: Disability Financial Assistance
programs.eligibility: Disabled adults without children awaiting SSI

civilRightsFramework.retaliationProhibitions: Retaliation prohibited for filing charges, testifying, or assisting in investigations

accommodationObligations.standard: Reasonable accommodation required; follows ADA framework

enablingStatutes.disability: No state TDI; ORC Chapter 5101 (public assistance)

laborStandards.agency: Ohio Dept. of Commerce, Bureau of Wage and Hour Administration

occupationalSafety.authority: Ohio is not a state plan state; OSHA covers private sector; BWC provides safety consultation

filingDeadlines.wcClaim: 2 years from injury or last compensation payment
filingDeadlines.civilRightsLawsuit: 6 years under ORC 4112 (recent case law); or 2 years for personal injury claims

evidentiaryStandards.wc: Preponderance of evidence; medical evidence required

judicialReview.wc: DHO → SHO → IC → Common Pleas → Court of Appeals → Supreme Court
judicialReview.civilRights: OCRC → Common Pleas (or direct filing) → Court of Appeals
judicialReview.directFiling: May file directly in court without exhausting OCRC

specialConsiderations.monopolisticStateFund: Ohio is one of 4 monopolistic fund states; all employers must use BWC State Insurance Fund or qualify as self-insured
specialConsiderations.industrialCommission: Unique two-agency system: BWC handles claims administration/insurance; Industrial Commission handles disputed claims adjudication
specialConsiderations.healthAndSafetyProgram: BWC Division of Safety & Hygiene provides employer consultation and training
specialConsiderations.historyAndReform: Multiple rounds of reform; managed care organizations now handle medical management
